title: Laptop answer-QR scan actually starts
summary: Fixes a latent Phase-2b.2 bug surfaced by 2b.5 real-device QA. With the phone now loading from the public deployment, the user reached step 2 — the laptop webcam scanning the phone's answer QR — for the first time, and it silently did nothing: the camera turned on but no video appeared, no scanning ran, and the handshake timed out to `Error`. Root cause: `PairScreen.handleStartScan` read `videoRef.current` while the pair state was still `'showing-offer'`, but the `<video>` element only renders in `'scanning-answer'` (`QrPanel`), so the ref was null and the handler early-returned BEFORE `setQrState('scanning-answer')` and `scheduleScan()`. The `getUserMedia` stream was acquired (camera LED on) but never attached and never scanned — never caught earlier because the 2b.2 camera path's manual QA was never performed (manual_qa device_used: 'not_performed_by_agent'). Fix: `handleStartScan` now acquires the stream, stores it in `streamRef`, and sets `'scanning-answer'`; a new `qrState`-keyed effect attaches the stream to the `<video>` and starts the jsQR loop once the element is mounted (no more null-ref ordering hazard). Camera capture now requests 1280×720 ideal (the ~640×480 webcam default renders the dense answer QR below one pixel, so jsQR could never decode even when scanning ran). Added a live scanning indicator (`data-testid="scan-status"`) with a frames-checked counter and a pointer to the manual-pairing fallback — the missing feedback was the user's explicit complaint. Lint + tsc + vitest (289) + vite build all clean; main bundle unchanged (PairScreen lazy chunk +0.19 KB gzip).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Clicking 'turn on camera' transitions to scanning-answer, mounts the <video>, and starts the jsQR loop.
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: `PairScreen.handleStartScan` sets `streamRef.current` + `setQrState('scanning-answer')`; a new `useEffect([qrState])` attaches `video.srcObject` and calls `scheduleScan()` once the element mounts. verify-phase-2b6.mjs C1 (Chromium fake camera) PASS: after clicking `[aria-label="start scan"]`, `[data-testid="pair-state"]` becomes `scanning-answer`, `[data-testid="answer-video"]` is present, and the scan-status frame counter advances past 0. This FAILS before the fix (state never leaves `showing-offer`) — the regression gate.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Camera capture requests a resolution high enough to decode the dense answer QR.
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: `handleStartScan` calls `getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: 'user', width: { ideal: 1280 }, height: { ideal: 720 } } })`. The decode-at-distance improvement is a §B2 manual gate (M2) — headless verification cannot exercise real jsQR decode of a real phone-screen QR.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A live scanning indicator gives the operator feedback that the camera is working.
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: `QrPanel` renders `data-testid="scan-status"` (role=status) while `qrState === 'scanning-answer'`, showing a frames-checked count (incremented per scan tick in `scheduleScan`) and a pointer to 'Show manual pairing'. verify-phase-2b6.mjs C1 asserts the counter text advances past 0.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Lint + tsc + vitest + vite build clean; main bundle not regressed.
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: All clean. 289/289 vitest (unchanged — the fix is in the getUserMedia/jsQR path gated by the verify script per §B2). Main bundle 357.05 KB / 109.84 KB gzip (unchanged vs 2b.5). PairScreen lazy chunk 141.82 KB / 51.69 KB gzip (+0.47 KB raw / +0.19 KB gzip).

verify-phase-2b6.mjs C1 PASS (fake camera, 0 console errors; artifacts/phase-2b6-verify/results.json). M1 (real webcam decodes the phone answer QR → connected within ~5s), M2 (dense QR decodes at arm's length with the higher resolution), M3 (manual-paste fallback still completes a connection) pending operator sign-off per the §B2 browser-API manual gate.

playwright_run.automated_gate_checks: C1 PASS — with Chromium's fake camera (--use-fake-device-for-media-stream), clicking 'I scanned the QR — turn on camera' transitions pair-state to scanning-answer, mounts the answer <video>, and the scan-status frame counter advances ('1 frame checked'). Zero console errors. This is the regression gate: before the fix the click no-ops and the state stays showing-offer, so the waitForFunction times out and C1 fails.

checklist_pending_operator_sign_off: M1 — Real webcam: point the phone's answer QR at the laptop camera → laptop decodes within ~5s and PairScreen reaches `connected`.
M2 — Dense answer QR decodes at normal arm's length (higher-resolution capture), not only pressed to the lens.
M3 — Manual-pairing fallback (paste answer SDP) still completes a connection when the webcam cannot decode.
manual_qa.operator_sign_off_instructions: Update artifacts/phase-2b6-verify/results.json — set each entry's `signed_off` to {date:'YYYY-MM-DD', device:'<laptop OS + browser version> / <phone model>'} after exercising on a real laptop webcam against a real phone answer QR. Headless Chromium's fake camera emits a synthetic pattern, not a decodable QR, so the automated check gates only that scanning *starts*; real decode→connected is the manual gate. M1 proves the end-to-end webcam decode now works; M2 proves the resolution bump fixed decode reliability; M3 confirms the documented fallback.

gates.testing: verify-phase-2b6.mjs C1 is the regression gate (fails before the fix). Per the §B2 concession, the getUserMedia + jsQR + RTCPeerConnection path is gated by the Playwright verify script, not jsdom unit tests (PairScreen constructs its own RTCPeerConnection, absent under jsdom). The 289 vitest tests remain green. M1–M3 manual checklist covers real webcam decode.
gates.dry: No duplication introduced. The scan loop (`scheduleScan`) and stream lifecycle (`stopScanning`) remain single-sourced; the stream-attach moved from the click handler into one `qrState`-keyed effect.
gates.drift: No prior-phase invariants broken. The 2b.5 routing/URL work is untouched. The manual-paste fallback (2b.1) and the QR offer path are unchanged. Only the answer-scan start sequence + capture constraints + a feedback line changed.
gates.planning: No separate planning round — localized bug fix within the pairing UI surface already analysed during 2b.5. Recorded in decision-memo.md §'Phase 2b.6'; phase-update.json updated.
gates.verification_sprint: Pre-phase: 289/289 + lint + tsc + build clean (2b.5 boundary). Post-phase: identical suite green; verify-phase-2b6.mjs C1 PASS, 0 console errors. verify-phase-2b5.mjs gate checks remain valid (routing unchanged).

review.code_reviewer: Self-reviewed against the gate checklist (the bug + fix are small and mechanical: a render-order/null-ref hazard). The fix removes the hazard by deferring stream attach to a post-mount effect, adds a documented eslint-disable for the intentional single-run effect deps, and is covered by a would-fail-before regression check. A full code-reviewer agent pass was run on the 2b.5 diff that introduced this file's recent changes; 2b.6 is a focused follow-on.
review.architecture_red_team: Not re-invoked — no architectural surface changed (no new module, route, persistence, or network behaviour). The red-team's 2b.5 finding that the reverse-QR-over-webcam path is finicky is directly mitigated here (higher resolution + feedback + explicit manual-fallback pointer).
review.qa_playwright: verify-phase-2b6.mjs C1 (fake camera) is the automated gate; M1–M3 manual checklist is the authoritative gate for real webcam decode under §B2.

suggested_commit_message: phase-2b.6: fix laptop answer-QR scan never starting (null videoRef on click) + higher capture res + scan feedback
